description: Photo-style fictional landscape; not a photograph of an identified real location.
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide landscape photograph for a quiet self-reflection app header. Primary request: a serene misty freshwater lake at dawn, forested Japanese mountain foothills reflected in still water, a small natural grassy bank in the foreground, soft layers of pale morning mist and distant forest. Style: realistic editorial landscape photography with natural detail, subtle grain, not illustration or fantasy. Composition: panoramic landscape 3:1, horizon around upper third, balanced unhurried scenery, generous calm dark evergreen lake area on the left to support white UI text overlaid separately, soft brighter mist on the right. Palette: muted forest green, sage, blue-grey mist, very subtle warm dawn light. No people, buildings, boats, text, typography, logos or watermarks. No dramatic orange sunset, oversaturation, or artificial glow. Generate only the photograph, not a UI mockup.
